question: What should be made on the fast-breaking day once it has arrived, dear one?
premises: a cow-face is to be made
the instruction is addressed to the dear one
inference: on the fast-breaking day, once it has arrived, one should make a cow-face
uncertainties: whether prāpte is a locative absolute or adjective modifying the day
whether kārayetpriye is one fused token or two words in the edition
plain_english: On the fast-breaking day, once it has arrived, make a cow-face, dear one.
